3.speaker: Lucita Azaro
3.text: "Let me start by saying that I've made significant progress into who may be responsible."

5.speaker: Lucita Azaro
5.text: "Unfortunately, yes. There are several individuals I find highly suspicious."

6.speaker: Lucita Azaro
6.text: "My initial list comprised five individuals: Captain Gordion, Grand Wiseman Ignacius, your butler, your uncle, and your mother."

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: Lucita discreetly glanced around as if making sure there was no one else with us.

9.speaker: Player_Romus
9.text: "I hope you've narrowed it down from there."

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "My mother? How dare you insinuate such an awful thing."

11.speaker: Lucita Azaro
11.text: "You wouldn't have asked me to investigate if you thought I was guilty."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "Tell me what you’ve learned -- no matter how hard it is to hear."

14.speaker: Player_Romus
14.text: "I hope you're armed with substantial evidence."

15.speaker: Lucita Azaro
15.text: "As a matter of fact, I have."

16.speaker: Lucita Azaro
16.text: "I meant no offense. You instructed me to investigate everyone present at the palace during that time."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "Tell me about my uncle. Why him?"

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "This is all too vague. I want cold, hard facts."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "I seriously find it hard to believe that my uncle would murder his brother."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "If your account is accurate, we need to find out more."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "I'm glad you did. If what you're saying is true, we must handle this delicately."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "Sorry, but what you're implying sounds too far-fetched."

29.speaker: Player_Romus
29.text: "Tell me all the details about my mother's whereabouts on the night my father passed."

31.speaker: Lucita Azaro
31.text: "Your Majesty, our investigative efforts have unveiled a rather unexpected revelation."

32.speaker: Lucita Azaro
32.text: "The Queen Mother was at dinner that night. Later, as verified by Titus Gordion, she opened the door to your father's chambers and immediately alerted the Golden Guard that he was unconscious."

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "If this is your idea of a joke, I'm not laughing."

38.speaker: Lucita Azaro
38.text: "Your guardsman's behavior was suspicious, to say the least."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "I find this accusation hard to believe. Titus has been nothing but loyal from day one."

40.speaker: Lucita Azaro
40.text: "On the night of King Valero's death, Captain Gordion was charged with guarding his chambers."

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "He probably just went to the toilet."

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "He wasn't at his post? That's not like Titus at all."

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "Did he or anyone else enter my father's room during that time?"

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "Not in the palace? Then where the hell was she?"

51.speaker: Player_Romus
51.text: "So my mother has her own share of secrets... guess that makes her human after all."

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "He's often taken it upon himself to personally oversee the king's security."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "This only confirms my suspicions that he can't be trusted."

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "This is troubling news indeed. I've always taken Titus to be a loyal protector."

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "There must be some mistake. As far as I'm concerned he is the epitome of honor and loyalty."

62.speaker: Player_Romus
62.text: "I want to know why you suspect Pabel."

63.speaker: Narrator
63.text: She took a quick look around before proceeding.

64.speaker: Lucita Azaro
64.text: "I'm merely presenting the facts, Your Majesty. It's unusual for someone in Pabel's position to be absent for such a long period."

65.speaker: Lucita Azaro
65.text: "As you know, it is my duty to explore every possibility."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "Just because he was unaccounted for doesn't mean he had anything to do with my father's death."

68.speaker: Lucita Azaro
68.text: "During the time leading up to Valero's death, there was a significant period when he couldn't be accounted for."

71.speaker: Lucita Azaro
71.text: "He has access to the inner workings of the palace, which made him a person of interest -- a detail that couldn't be overlooked."

77.speaker: Lucita Azaro
77.text: "Further investigation, however, revealed that Pabel had a solid alibi. His whereabouts during that time can be completely accounted for."

80.speaker: Narrator
80.text: Lucita bowed and bid me good day before she turned and left my side.
80.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_PromisedDate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Lucita"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true) == false)

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "Is that all? That doesn't prove he had a hand in anything."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "You were right to come to me, however, we need something more concrete before jumping to conclusions."

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "Then I was correct in believing my father's untimely end was no accident."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "An eyewitness? What led you to find that out?"

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "If this information is inaccurate in any way, there will  be hell to pay."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "This is a lot to process. I'm having a hard time believing any of it."

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "My God... A Dastnurist service? How can this be?"

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "I want to hear about what you found on the Grand Wiseman."

96.speaker: Lucita Azaro
96.text: "Your Majesty, multiple sources have confirmed to me that the Grand Wiseman visited the king's chambers the night of his death."

97.speaker: Lucita Azaro
97.text: "In fact, at that time he was consulting privately with the King on a near-nightly basis."

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "Makes sense. He had plenty to atone for."

99.speaker: Lucita Azaro
99.text: "What's interesting is that aside from those meetings, witnesses describe your father's behavior as no more religious than usual."

100.speaker: Lucita Azaro
100.text: "He was even skipping services some weeks."

101.speaker: Lucita Azaro
101.text: "Yes, however, it's unusual for someone in Pabel's position to remain absent for an extended duration."

102.speaker: Lucita Azaro
102.text: "I'm sure. But for an individual in Pabel's position to be away for such a prolonged period raised questions."

103.speaker: Lucita Azaro
103.text: "As you know, to have someone of his status go missing for such an extended duration would raise suspicions."

104.speaker: Lucita Azaro
104.text: "Especially with Pabel's knowledge of the inner workings of the palace."

105.speaker: Lucita Azaro
105.text: "Could his absence be a coincidence? Sure. But it was something I couldn't overlook."

106.speaker: Lucita Azaro
106.text: "He has access to the palace's internal operations, which made him a noteworthy figure in my inquiry."

107.speaker: Lucita Azaro
107.text: "While it might be coincidental, it was a detail we couldn't ignore."

108.speaker: Lucita Azaro
108.text: "He possesses knowledge of the palace's internal workings, which rendered him a significant figure in my investigation."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "How wise of my father. I hope he found the serenity he was seeking."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "My father turned towards God... and away from everyone else."

111.speaker: Lucita Azaro
111.text: "It's not surprising. God forgives where humans don't."

114.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
114.conditionsRaw:
Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectHugo"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectSal"] == true  or  
Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectTitus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectLucita"] == true

115.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
115.conditionsRaw:
(Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectHugo"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectSal"] == true  or  
Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectTitus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectLucita"] == true) == false

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "Here are the next steps for your investigation."
116.conditionsRaw:
Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectHugo"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectSal"] == true  or  
Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectTitus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectLucita"] == true

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "Hugo is obviously our primary suspect, so focus your investigation on him."

118.speaker: Player_Romus
118.text: "Discreetly continue your investigation into Titus. He has eyes and ears everywhere."

119.speaker: Player_Romus
119.text: "This investigation has gone as far as it can go. Cease all further efforts, effective immediately."

120.speaker: Player_Romus
120.text: "I hate to say it, but keep looking into Sal. There's more to the Grand Wiseman than he's letting on."

124.speaker: Player_Romus
124.text: "Keep digging into Sal. There's more to the Wiseman than he's letting on."

125.speaker: Lucita Azaro
125.text: "Yes, Your Majesty. I'll get my stealthiest agents on the case."

126.speaker: Lucita Azaro
126.text: "Very good, Your Majesty. Rest assured, I will get to the bottom of this as soon as possible."

127.speaker: Lucita Azaro
127.text: "Very well. But for the record, I still believe the actions of our suspects warrant further scrutiny."

133.speaker: Player_Romus
133.text: "I had a funny feeling about that Golden Guardsman. There was something about him that never sat right with me."

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "If what you're saying is true, this angers me to no end."

136.speaker: Narrator
136.text: I didn't want to think about what would happen if Titus' suspicions were proven right.

137.speaker: Lucita Azaro
137.text: "Investigation aside... I would humbly remind you of that date you owe me."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "I still haven't found a setting befitting the beauty and majesty of the Duchess of House Azaro."

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "The King of Rizia has no time for such frivolities. And neither do you, Duchess."

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "I haven't forgotten. But we've both been busy."

141.speaker: Lucita Azaro
141.text: "Yes... of course. I'll look for something that fits into both of our schedules."

142.speaker: Narrator
142.text: She flashed a suggestive smile as she left the chambers.

144.speaker: Lucita Azaro
144.text: "I'm still looking forward to the day when we're not."

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: Now alone, my thoughts, once again, returned to the investigation.

146.speaker: Narrator
146.text: I assured myself that investigating Lucita was the right course of action.

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "You've already uncovered enough unpleasant secrets about the people around me. I'd rather not learn more."

155.speaker: Player_Romus
155.text: "I'll keep all of what you said in mind. But I don't see grounds for a full-blown investigation into any of these suspects."

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: "For the record, I don't. My father was an old, sick man. That's all there is to it."

164.speaker: Narrator
164.text: If he was to remain my bodyguard, I wanted to make sure he had no skeletons in his closet.

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: I assured myself that investigating Titus was the right course of action.
165.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateLucita"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateTitus"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateHugo"] == true) == false)

166.speaker: Narrator
166.text: I didn't want to think about what would happen if Lucita's suspicions were proven right?

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: I took no pleasure in it, but I was duty-bound to dispense God's justice.

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: But it had to be done.

175.speaker: Narrator
175.text: I assured myself that investigating Sal was the right course of action.
175.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateLucita"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateTitus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateSal"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateHugo"] == true) == false)

176.speaker: Narrator
176.text: And if my suspicions turned out to be true, especially regarding a man of faith, it begged the question... who could I trust?

177.speaker: Narrator
177.text: I assured myself that halting the investigation was the right thing to do.
177.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateLucita"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateTitus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateSal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateHugo"] == true) == false)

178.speaker: Narrator
178.text: I was becoming as paranoid as my father. For the sake of my own well-being, it had to stop.

179.speaker: Titus Gordion
179.text: "Very good, Your Majesty. I'll work diligently to uncover the truth as soon as possible."

180.speaker: Titus Gordion
180.text: "Very well. For the record, I still believe the actions of our suspects warrant further scrutiny."

194.speaker: Narrator
194.text: Titus bowed and bid me good day before he turned and left.
194.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_PromisedDate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Lucita"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true)

196.speaker: Titus Gordion
196.text: "Allow me to begin by stating that I've made significant headway in identifying potential culprits."

197.speaker: Titus Gordion
197.text: "Regrettably, yes. Multiple individuals raised strong suspicions."

198.speaker: Titus Gordion
198.text: "My initial list of suspects comprised five individuals. Lucita Azaro, Grand Wiseman Ignacius, your butler, your uncle, and your mother."

199.speaker: Narrator
199.text: Titus discreetly looked around as if making sure there was no one else with us.

213.speaker: Lucita Azaro
213.text: "Yes, it seems you were right after all. And I believe I've narrowed it down to a handful of possible suspects."

214.speaker: Titus Gordion
214.text: "That appears to be the case. I've narrowed it down to a handful of possible suspects."

215.speaker: Lucita Azaro
215.text: "I've identified several individuals who initially raised significant suspicions."

216.speaker: Titus Gordion
216.text: "I've pinpointed several individuals who initially aroused considerable suspicion and warranted closer examination."

226.speaker: Titus Gordion
226.text: "Presumably, you tasked me with the investigation because I'm not under suspicion."

230.speaker: Titus Gordion
230.text: "Sir, our investigation has uncovered some intriguing findings."

231.speaker: Titus Gordion
231.text: "The Queen Mother was at dinner that night. Later, as I personally witnessed, she opened the door to your father's chambers and immediately alerted the Golden Guard that he was unconscious."

232.speaker: Lucita Azaro
232.text: "It certainly does. That said, you might be shocked to learn the nature of her secret outing."

236.speaker: Titus Gordion
236.text: "It certainly does. As for the nature of her whereabouts, you might be surprised to learn that she was attending a religious service just outside the capital."

237.speaker: Lucita Azaro
237.text: "Not so fast, Your Majesty. This may come as a shock, but as it happens, she was attending a religious service just outside the capital."

241.speaker: Titus Gordion
241.text: "That depends on how you look at it. This may come as a surprise, but as it happens, she was attending a religious service just outside the capital."

242.speaker: Lucita Azaro
242.text: "This may come as a shock, but it turns out, she was attending a clandestine religious service just outside the capital."

246.speaker: Titus Gordion
246.text: "This may come as a surprise, but it turns out, she was attending a religious service just outside the capital."

247.speaker: Lucita Azaro
247.text: "We managed to find credible eyewitnesses at the Dastnurist archsanctuary that night who can verify it."

251.speaker: Titus Gordion
251.text: "One of my Golden Guards, who was assigned to protect her, confirmed it."

252.speaker: Lucita Azaro
252.text: "It's no joke. Credible eyewitnesses were present at the archsanctuary that night who can verify it."

256.speaker: Titus Gordion
256.text: "It's no joke, sir. One of my Golden Guards, who was assigned to protect her, confirmed it."

257.speaker: Lucita Azaro
257.text: "All I know is that multiple eyewitnesses at the Dastnurist archsanctuary that night can verify it."

261.speaker: Titus Gordion
261.text: "All I know is that one of my Golden Guards, who was assigned to protect her, confirmed it."

271.speaker: Player_Romus
271.text: "Dastnurity aside, it's a relief to hear she's no longer a suspect."

272.speaker: Player_Romus
272.text: "Sure, but it still doesn't excuse her attendance at a Dastnurist gathering. It's an affront to our faith!"

273.speaker: Player_Romus
273.text: "Your slow approach to sharing crucial information is frustrating. Get to the point faster next time."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "Then I suppose I'll have to find another suspect."

275.speaker: Lucita Azaro
275.text: "Needless to say, this proves your mother had an alibi, and had nothing to do with your father's death."

276.speaker: Titus Gordion
276.text: "Needless to say, this establishes an alibi for your mother -- that she had no involvement in your father's death."

277.speaker: Lucita Azaro
277.text: "Of all the individuals I've been looking into, your Uncle Hugo stands out the most."

281.speaker: Titus Gordion
281.text: "After supper on the night Valero died, His Grace accompanied the King to his chambers."

282.speaker: Lucita Azaro
282.text: "After supper on the night Valero died, His Grace accompanied the King to his chambers."

288.speaker: Lucita Azaro
288.text: "Believe it or not, but facts are facts."

293.speaker: Lucita Azaro
293.text: "Forgive my bluntness, but what more do you need? We must get to the bottom of what happened between the two of them."

297.speaker: Titus Gordion
297.text: "I believe that such behavior is enough to warrant further scrutiny."

298.speaker: Lucita Azaro
298.text: "If we keep pursuing this lead, we will get them."

302.speaker: Titus Gordion
302.text: "If we continue our investigation, we will deliver them."

303.speaker: Lucita Azaro
303.text: "Given the severity of accusing the Grand Vizier of murder, I wanted to inform you first before proceeding."

307.speaker: Titus Gordion
307.text: "Given the potential uproar from accusing the Grand Vizier of murder, I wanted to inform you before proceeding."

309.speaker: Lucita Azaro
309.text: "Yes. He stuck to His Majesty like glue, much as he currently sticks to you."

310.speaker: Lucita Azaro
310.text: "Titus guarded your father's quarters almost every night. Without fail."

311.speaker: Lucita Azaro
311.text: "It is, which raises questions about his loyalty and the circumstances surrounding the king's demise."

313.speaker: Lucita Azaro
313.text: "The other guardsman claims nothing happened. But he could have been covering for his colleague..."

314.speaker: Lucita Azaro
314.text: "Your admiration of Captain Gordion is notable, but our duty sometimes requires us to question even the most loyal among us."

315.speaker: Lucita Azaro
315.text: "I understand your reservations, but my duty is to uncover the truth, no matter how uncomfortable it may be."

316.speaker: Lucita Azaro
316.text: "I understand. But my responsibility is to unveil the truth, no matter how unsettling it might be."

318.speaker: Lucita Azaro
318.text: "I've had my reservations about him as well. It's always best to trust your instincts in such matters."

319.speaker: Lucita Azaro
319.text: "I share your frustration. If these allegations hold up, it's a betrayal that none of us could have foreseen."

323.speaker: Titus Gordion
323.text: "Your Majesty, I myself admitted the Grand Wiseman into the king's chambers the night of his death."

324.speaker: Titus Gordion
324.text: "I thought nothing of it at the time. The two of them had been consulting privately on a near-nightly basis."

325.speaker: Titus Gordion
325.text: "Religion is often a source of comfort to those who feel abandoned by everything and everyone else."

329.speaker: Titus Gordion
329.text: "What's interesting is that aside from those meetings, witnesses describe your father's behavior as no more religious than usual."

336.speaker: Titus Gordion
336.text: "He was even skipping services some weeks."

340.speaker: Titus Gordion
340.text: "As you know, I've been tasked with exploring every possibility."

341.speaker: Titus Gordion
341.text: "Prior to Valero's passing, there was an extended period during which his movements couldn't be traced."

342.speaker: Titus Gordion
342.text: "Having someone of his status go missing for such an extended duration indeed raises suspicions."

343.speaker: Titus Gordion
343.text: "I'm merely presenting the facts, sir. It's unusual for someone in Pabel's position to be absent for such a long time."

347.speaker: Titus Gordion
347.text: "Yes, although it's uncommon for someone in Pabel's position to be absent for an extended period..."

357.speaker: Titus Gordion
357.text: "I'm sure, but it's unusual for someone in Pabel's position to be absent for such an extended period. It raised concerns."

358.speaker: Titus Gordion
358.text: "Having access to the inner workings of the palace elevated his importance in my investigation."

359.speaker: Titus Gordion
359.text: "Because of this, it was a detail that couldn't be ignored."

360.speaker: Titus Gordion
360.text: "He possesses knowledge of the palace's internal workings, which makes him a significant figure in my investigation."

361.speaker: Titus Gordion
361.text: "His access to the inner workings of the palace made him a person of interest. It was a detail that couldn't be overlooked."

362.speaker: Titus Gordion
362.text: "And with Pabel's grasp of the palace's internal workings, this took on added significance."

363.speaker: Titus Gordion
363.text: "It's possible that his absence during that time was a mere coincidence. However, it's something that couldn't be overlooked."

364.speaker: Titus Gordion
364.text: "Further investigation, however, revealed that your butler had a solid alibi. His whereabouts during that time can be completely accounted for."

369.speaker: Titus Gordion
369.text: "My suspicions stem from Lucita allegedly visiting King Valero's chambers on the night of his passing."

371.speaker: Titus Gordion
371.text: "When I returned, he informed me nothing out of the ordinary had occurred. But pressed for details during this investigation, he admitted he had allowed Duchess Azaro access to the room for a brief period."

372.speaker: Player_Romus
372.text: "You're implying they were secret lovers or something?"

373.speaker: Player_Romus
373.text: "Allegedly? You were guarding my father's chambers. Wouldn't you know if she visited?"

376.speaker: Titus Gordion
376.text: "I would never suggest such a thing. However..."

377.speaker: Titus Gordion
377.text: "When I questioned the guardsman, he claimed Lucita had provided him with an order signed by your father."

380.speaker: Player_Romus
380.text: "If true, we need to verify its authenticity."

381.speaker: Titus Gordion
381.text: "I suspect she may have been carrying a correspondence letter, but I cannot confirm it."

382.speaker: Titus Gordion
382.text: "I have no reason not to. Being a Golden Guardsman means maintaining the highest level of integrity and loyalty. But as I was saying..."

383.speaker: Titus Gordion
383.text: "When we searched your father's chambers later, we found no evidence of a summons."

384.speaker: Player_Romus
384.text: "This is deeply troubling. What could Lucita be hiding?"

385.speaker: Player_Romus
385.text: "I have a hard time wrapping my head around Lucita doing something so drastic."

386.speaker: Player_Romus
386.text: "I always suspected that, when it came to the throne, House Azaro was out for blood."

390.speaker: Titus Gordion
390.text: "People can surprise us, for better or for worse. In any case..."

391.speaker: Titus Gordion
391.text: "That's a question I hope to find out."

392.speaker: Player_Romus
392.text: "Keep looking into Lucita's motivation. You might be onto something there."

396.speaker: Narrator
396.text: Alone once again, my thoughts returned to the investigation.

400.speaker: Titus Gordion
400.text: "I meant no offense, sir. You told me to investigate everyone present at the palace during that time."

404.speaker: Titus Gordion
404.text: "Yes, that's what I'm here to talk about."

405.speaker: Lucita Azaro
405.text: "Trust can be a double-edged sword, and it's disheartening when broken."

407.speaker: Player_Romus
407.text: "Lucita. To what do I owe this pleasure?"

409.speaker: Player_Romus
409.text: "Please tell me you're here because you have information on my father's passing."

410.speaker: Lucita Azaro
410.text: "Yes, I have, in fact, made significant progress on the investigation."

411.speaker: Player_Romus
411.text: "Oh, do tell! I'm eager to know what you've uncovered."

412.speaker: Lucita Azaro
412.text: "Only that I may have some information regarding your father's demise."

413.speaker: Player_Romus
413.text: "Really? In that case, let's hear it."

414.speaker: Player_Romus
414.text: "Well, what are you waiting for? Spit it out."

415.speaker: Lucita Azaro
415.text: "'This pleasure' happens to be the information you requested about your father's death."

416.speaker: Narrator
416.text: And the city's distant lights shimmered, a testament to life continuing beyond the palace walls.

417.speaker: Narrator
417.text: His presence on the balcony hinted at an urgent matter, a reminder that, as a monarch, even moments of solitude could be fleeting.

419.speaker: Player_Romus
419.text: "What are you doing lurking in the dark?"

420.speaker: Player_Romus
420.text: "To what do I owe the pleasure, Captain?"

421.speaker: Player_Romus
421.text: "Ah, it's you. Is everything all right?"

422.speaker: Player_Romus
422.text: "If you have something to report, make it quick."

423.speaker: Titus Gordion
423.text: "The one concerning His Majesty, King Valero."
